item.title: Show HN: Moorage – a better way to mount and view MTP devices in macOS
item.summary: I needed a way to quickly mount and view data from a device that uses MTP, and I hated the other file-view solutions that existed, So I made one with claude. If you regularly mount MTP devices (Kindle, Camera, Switch, etc) this might be useful to you! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49170492 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
